title: The Giant Heart
seo_title: Heart-Shaped Charcuterie Board: 50 Meat Roses & Shopping List
description: A giant heart charcuterie board for 12 to 15: about 50 salami, prosciutto and mortadella roses with strawberries, raspberries, brie and goat cheese.
hook: About 50 meat roses, one enormous heart.

items.name: Mild white cheese such as Jarlsberg or Swiss

why: Every rose is made the same way, with a small glass, so 50 roses is just repetition. Dark salami or soppressata roses, pink prosciutto and pale mortadella give three shades.
Strawberries, raspberries, brie and goat cheese fill the rest of the heart. It's made for Valentine's Day, Galentine's, anniversaries and bridal showers.

timeline.what: Roll all the salami roses (keep them covered on a sheet pan in the fridge), and slice the cheeses.
Hull and halve the strawberries and pat the berries dry.
Build the heart from the outside in, then add the brie and the cheeses around it.
Add the chocolate, almonds and crackers.

faq.q: How do you make meat roses with a glass?
faq.a: Layer overlapping slices of salami around the rim of a small glass, then flip it out. The book shows the exact method and how many slices each rose takes.
About 90 minutes, mostly making roses. It's rated 2 of 5 because it just takes patience.

Make the roses the day before and keep them covered in the fridge. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
